name: background-aware-agent-liveness-monitoring
title: Make reviewer and worker liveness background-aware instead of restarting after ten minutes
description: Current reviewer and worker guidance treats ten minutes without a result as stalled even though host-native agents may remain alive in the background and complete much later. Replace elapsed-time restart advice with authoritative host-status monitoring: running/background tasks keep being monitored; unknown state remains non-duplicating and observable; restart is allowed only after terminal failure, cancellation, missing task/process, or another conclusive dead-state signal.

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: The word production only describes existing prompt entrypoints; this story does not touch a production environment or perform an emergency operation.
